name: Whaler Obed

intro.text: Nothing here but scrub, crabs and the occasional ghost. I was on the Essex. Do you know what a whale does to a ship? Hold that thought. I'd rather show you.

win: Ah. There's the water, finally. I needed that.
after: Henderson has a spring on the north beach. It cost us a good deal of time to find it. Don't take it for granted.
